cases.blind_spot_if_unflagged: The evaluator raises no correctness finding against the real Phase-114 design: the non-discriminating-instrument defect that the programme itself found only by execution is invisible to the evaluator as operated, in this design as in the era's own gate.
cases.defect_class: non-discriminating instrument in a real historical design (programme-falsified)
cases.expected_catcher: none in the gate as operated — historically caught by execution, which is the gap this battery documents
cases.name: The real Spec 026-era design (Phase-114 blind affiliation, Spec 012)
cases.determination_rule: Flagged only if a correctness finding names the instrument's failure to discriminate; a run that extracts no assessable claims is a blind spot by the design's own rule (the evaluator cannot be run against the case in its current form).

cases.blind_spot_if_unflagged: The evaluator does not detect a falsifier that is present in form and empty in substance: the planted headline claim FB2-C01 passes with no correctness finding naming its untestable test.
cases.defect_class: unfalsifiable headline claim (falsifier present in form, empty in substance)
cases.expected_catcher: the evaluator's falsifiability/irreducibility challenges, if they bite on substance rather than form
cases.name: Planted unfalsifiable headline claim
cases.determination_rule: Flagged only if a correctness finding against FB2-C01 names the falsifiability defect (empty/circular/untestable falsifier). Independence or hygiene findings do not count: they fire on sound registers too.

cases.blind_spot_if_unflagged: The evaluator does not recompute pinned quantities against their cited sources: a total of 52 pinned against a source summing to 47 passes without a correctness finding. C2 (independent recomputation) is the component that carries this class.
cases.defect_class: pinned quantity arithmetically wrong against its own cited source
cases.expected_catcher: C2 independent recomputation (the evaluator is not an arithmetic engine)
cases.name: Planted wrong pin (52 against a source summing to 47)
cases.determination_rule: Flagged only if a correctness finding identifies the pinned quantities as wrong against SOURCE.md. Independence or hygiene findings do not count.

cases.blind_spot_if_unflagged: The evaluator verifies that citations resolve, not that they support: claims stating the opposite of their cited records pass in both the freeze configuration and with evidence verification on. C3's verification step — a verifier reading the cited text against the claim — is the component that carries this class.
cases.defect_class: evidence citation that does not support its claim
cases.expected_catcher: C3 evidence verification with a human/verifier read of the cited text (the engine checks resolution and hashes, not support)
cases.name: Planted unsupported citations (claims stating the opposite of their cited records)
cases.determination_rule: Flagged only if a correctness finding on an FB4 claim identifies that its cited evidence does not support it (in either run). missing_ref resolution findings do not count: the refs resolve inside the repo; support, not resolution, is the defect.
